maria: Quick design review — table row actions. Suggestion: collapse secondary actions into an overflow menu to reduce visual noise, but keep primary action (open) as a visible button. Also we need to decide toast behavior on delete: persistent undo vs ephemeral. And keyboard focus order — currently jumpy. ash: I'm leaning overflow menu too. On hover show 2 icons (open, more). For keyboard users, tab should land on the row, then on the first actionable control. We should not rely on hover-only actions. :+1: kevin: A11y note — if actions are hidden on hover we must ensure they're still reachable via keyboard and screen readers. Right now the Delete icon has no aria-label in the markup (a11y scan flagged it). Also check focus-visible styles; our focus ring gets clipped by the table cell padding. sam: Agree with kevin. Proposal: always render the actions in DOM but visually collapse with CSS so screen readers see them. Example: show only the primary action visually, and move others into a dropdown. For spacing, can we use the compact spacing token for dense tables? Some customers use 8px rows for list-like tables. maria: Good. If we go dropdown for secondary actions we should keep Delete as a destructive item in the overflow, not the primary button. That reduces accidental deletes and keeps row simple. For toasts: make delete toast persistent for 10s with an Undo action. If stack grows, collapse into a single "3 items deleted" toast with undo. ash: UX nit — toast placement for table actions should anchor to the bottom-right of the console panel, not floating over the table header. That keeps it out of the content area. Also use subtle animation, not jarring. kevin: Implementation details for keyboard: tab sequence should be Row checkbox (if present) -> Primary action -> Overflow menu -> Next row. Use aria-haspopup and aria-expanded on the overflow. Example snippet: ```html
``` maria: Perfect. Can we also standardize the spacing token for action buttons in tables? Currently some tables use --space-2 and others --space-3. Suggest token: --space-action-compact = 6px horizontally, 4px vertically. Sam, can you add that to the tokens doc? sam: Yep. I'll add an entry and a usage example. Quick CSS example: ```css .table-row .btn-icon { margin-left: var(--space-action-compact); padding: 4px 6px; /* compact */ } ``` a11y-bot: Automated scan results: "Missing aria-label on .btn-icon when icon-only and no visible text" (2 occurrences). Also flagged low contrast for the 'More' icon when inactive. Recommend adding aria-labels and checking tokenized color variables. maria: Thanks bot. Action items: 1) Sam — add spacing token and example (owner). 2) Engineering — implement overflow menu with aria attrs, keep primary action visible. 3) Product/Design — decide toast persistence: 10s with grouped collapse. 4) KEVIN — review focus outline clipping across table variants. ash: I'll make a small mock in Figma showing hover vs always-visible DOM states and post link here. kevin: I'll follow up with a short accessibility checklist for the dev PR: aria-labels, role=menu semantics, focus-visible, contrast, and keyboard order tests. maria: Thanks all. If we can get mocks + token PR by EOD Thursday we can slot this for next week's release. :calendar: sam: PR will include token bump and example display in the component docs. ash: Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/row-actions-compact (mock, WIP) maria: Closing loop — will open a tiny RFC with the decisions and assign owners. kevin: thx!
